[[Category: Presbyterian Ministers]]
[[Category: Westminster Cemetery, Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania]]
== Biography ==

Graduated Geneva College and Allegheny Seminary. Installed Pastor of Baltimore Reformed Presbyterian Congregation, 1885. 

Melanchthon was the author of <i>History of the Reformed Presbyterian Church in America</I>, 1888 [https://catalog.hathitrust.org/Record/008608020][https://books.google.com/books/about/History_of_the_Reformed_Presbyterian_Chu.html?id=FiJNAAAAYAAJ]. He also wrote a short [https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf History of the Glasgow family]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual parent review, 27 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-589|Moses Thomas Glasgow]] and mother [[Thompson-63146|Martha W. Thompson]] are each assessed at 96% (confident) for this complete profile identity. The original 1888 published biography explicitly names both parents; the distinctive full name, Geneva graduation in 1880, Allegheny Seminary and Baltimore pastorate identify this subject. These are two first individual reviews of existing attachments, from unmarked flags with no previous percentages. No live flags or attachments are changed.

Subjective 96% for this complete existing profile pair. The original 1888 published biography names both parents and matches William’s distinctive name, Geneva College graduation in 1880, Allegheny Seminary and Baltimore pastorate. This is the author’s own lifetime biographical statement, not a contemporary birth register. The attributed author also wrote the held family typescript, so the two accounts are not independent witnesses. Page 526 reports birth on 1 July 1856 at Northwood, Logan County; the retained profile says 5 July 1856 at Youngstown, Mahoning County. That vital conflict remains open and no vital field is changed. The retained 1850 William Glasgow census citation cannot describe this 1856-born subject and is not corroboration. Existing family attachments and live WikiTree certainty flags are unchanged; an unmarked prior flag is not a 0% baseline.

=== Death notice reviewed 28 October 2026 ===

The 1909 obituary names Moses T. Glasgow and Martha W. (Thompson) as William’s parents and repeats the 1 July 1856 Northwood birth statement. It reports his death shortly after 1 p.m. on Tuesday, 2 March 1909, aged 52, at St. Timothy’s Hospital, Philadelphia. The retained profile’s 3 March death date is now an explicit conflict.

The original issue title and obituary page were visually inspected. This is a contemporary published death notice, not a civil death certificate. Its retrospective family and career wording closely parallels the 1888 biography, so independent testimony about the parents or birth is not established. The retained profile gives 5 July 1856 at Youngstown and death on 3 March 1909; the notice gives 1 July 1856 at Northwood and death on 2 March 1909. Both conflicts remain open. The existing father and mother assessments stay at 96%; no vital field, attachment or live flag changes.

The notice also reports marriage to Elizabeth D. Mullen at Baltimore on 20 December 1888 and says his wife and two unnamed daughters survived him. Their separate identities remain to be researched; no family attachment is added from this notice.
